sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Features; CLI Commands; Remote Instance Management; Security Model
sources.finding: Terminal orchestrator runs named coding CLIs against prd.json/Beads tasks. It offers PRD generation, persisted sessions, progress memory, subagent tracing, headless execution and authenticated remote control on VPS/CI hosts.

sources.title: website/content/docs/parallel/overview.mdx
sources.locator: Parallel execution; Multi-Epic Sessions; What Happens
sources.finding: Optional parallel workers use task worktrees, a dependency graph, one session branch and serial merge queue, with conflict resolution and backup tags. Default is sequential; external incomplete dependencies block tasks.

sources.title: website/content/docs/configuration/options.mdx
sources.finding: Configurable agent/model/custom command, iteration caps, progress/log paths, optional autoCommit and subagent tracing levels.

sources.title: website/content/docs/configuration/sandbox.mdx
sources.locator: Platform Requirements; What It Does Not Protect; Configuration Options
sources.finding: Opt-in Bubblewrap on Linux or sandbox-exec on macOS; Windows needs WSL2. Configurable writable/read-only paths and network disable. No VM-level boundary or CPU/memory/process limits; auto can fall back off.

sources.title: v0.12.0
sources.finding: v0.12.0 was published 2026-05-13. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

sources.title: Ralph TUI website
sources.finding: Says the tool is open source under the MIT License. The site shows no price or pricing page.

sources.title: subsy/ralph-tui LICENSE (MIT)
sources.finding: The MIT License lets anyone obtain, use, copy and modify the software free of charge.

sources.title: Ralph TUI Pi agent plugin (v0.12.0)
sources.locator: src/plugins/agents/builtin/pi.ts lines 142-148 (plugin meta id pi, default command pi), release tag v0.12.0 commit 8191b80; registered in src/plugins/agents/builtin/index.ts
sources.finding: Release v0.12.0 bundles a built-in Pi Coding Agent plugin that launches the installed pi command as the task agent. A Grok plugin exists only on main after that release.

sources.title: Ralph TUI docs: Environment Variable Exclusion (v0.12.0)
sources.locator: website/content/docs/configuration/options.mdx lines 287-300 and the Max subscription example near line 392, release tag v0.12.0 commit 8191b80
sources.finding: Ralph TUI blocks *_API_KEY variables from agent subprocesses by default so the agent CLI uses its own sign-in, such as a Claude Max subscription, instead of an API key; envPassthrough allows a key through when wanted.

sources.title: Ralph TUI docs: JSON Tracker (v0.12.0)
sources.locator: website/content/docs/plugins/trackers/json.mdx lines 6-55 (JSON Tracker, Basic Usage), release tag v0.12.0 commit 8191b80
sources.finding: The built-in JSON tracker keeps tasks as user stories in a local prd.json with id, title, description, acceptance criteria, priority and a passes state; Ralph TUI marks passes true as tasks complete. External trackers (Beads, Jira, Linear) are optional alternatives.

sources.title: Ralph TUI README: install
sources.locator: README.md line 19 (bun install -g ralph-tui), commit c0424d7; npm package ralph-tui 0.12.0 published 2026-05-13
sources.finding: Ralph TUI installs as a public package from npm with bun install -g ralph-tui; no account or price is required.

sources.title: Ralph TUI README at v0.12.0
sources.locator: README.md lines 11 and 70 (AI Agents list), release v0.12.0 commit 8191b80
sources.finding: At release v0.12.0 the README names Claude Code, OpenCode, Factory Droid, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex and Kiro CLI as supported coding assistants.
